name: teams-chat
description: Two-way Microsoft Teams channel via Bot Framework: pipeline notifications + chat commands (webhook ingress through a tunnel)

configSchema.label: Microsoft App ID
configSchema.help: The bot's Azure app registration (Application/Client ID).

configSchema.label: Tenant ID
configSchema.help: Required for single-tenant apps: the Entra tenant GUID.

configSchema.label: Ingress token
configSchema.help: Any long random string — it becomes part of the public webhook URL (capability URL). e.g. `openssl rand -hex 24`.

configSchema.label: Notify conversation IDs
configSchema.help: Comma-separated Teams conversation IDs for notifications. Send any command (e.g. `/whoami`) to the bot; worca refuses it and Settings → Chat notifications shows 'Ignored /whoami from chat <id>'. That is the conversation ID.

configSchema.label: Allowed conversation IDs (commands)
configSchema.help: Comma-separated conversation IDs allowed to send commands. EMPTY = nobody: anyone in an allowed conversation controls worca-cc.
